notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.2
notes.content:
- Fixed a steam configuration issue that was preventing profile save progress from loading correctly on game start
- Fixed a post-match camera focus issue

notes.title: Version 1.0.1 Hotfix
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Backboard shatter audio is now properly pitched and volume controlled.
[*] The board showing player stats in world no longer has collision (so you can't get stuck behind it)
[*] The action that leaves the arena after selecting a reward can no longer be interrupted which could lead to a soft lock.
[/list]

notes.title: Next Fest Hooptown Hero Developer Stream
notes.content: Curious about Hooptown Hero?  Not sure if it's one of the 500 demos you want to install for Next Fest?  Come watch the developer attempt a few runs of Hooptown Hero and see if it's right for you!
